name: Home estimate with panel type and subsidy
covers: brand header with logo, share and call buttons
description: Verifies the default home estimate, subsidy and the TOPCon price range on a phone.
steps: Check the header shows the Saanvika Solar logo, a share button and a call button
Check the results show 3 kW, a system price of ₹2.00 – 2.10 lakh and a PM Surya Ghar subsidy of − ₹78,000
Tap the TOPCon panel type button
expected: The system price changes to ₹2.10 – 2.20 lakh and the subsidy still shows − ₹78,000.

name: Business mode hides prices
covers: no prices shown for commercial systems
description: Verifies commercial customers see a custom quote instead of any price.
steps: Look at the Your solar plan panel
expected: System price shows Custom quote, the subsidy tile shows Tax benefit with Ask us, and the Your cost after subsidy and Money back in tiles are not visible.

name: Bill entry updates the plan and guards an empty bill
description: Verifies clearing the bill shows a prompt and typing a new bill recalculates the system.
steps: Clear the Monthly electricity bill field
Check the plan headline reads Enter your monthly bill
Type 5000 into the Monthly electricity bill field
expected: The plan headline reads 5 kW rooftop solar and the system price shows ₹2.80 – 2.95 lakh.

name: Elevated structure and square yards
description: Verifies the elevated structure adds to the price and the roof area converts to square yards.
steps: Turn on the Elevated structure switch
Click the sq yd button next to the rooftop area
expected: The system price shows ₹2.09 – 2.19 lakh and the rooftop area field shows 111 sq yd.

name: Contact details are shown
description: Verifies customers can see how to reach Saanvika Solar.
steps: Scroll to the Talk to us section
expected: The section shows 85198 33679, 98853 15789, saanvikasolar@gmail.com, the Sarpavaram, Kakinada office address and www.saanvikasolar.in.
